title: Michael Don't Leave Me Here
blurb: 'MICHAEL, DON'T LEAVE ME HERE!' — one of FNAF lore's most emotionally devastating lines, screamed with genuine desperation. The series buries real tragedy under its jump scares, and this clip is where the mask slips. Play it dramatically when someone leaves a Discord call, or sincerely if you actually understand the lore.
origin: A line from Five Nights at Freddy's lore, adopted by the fandom.
